cards.title: SHOPTALK
cards.description: A work context specific conversation required to get an activity done.

cards.title: VISIONING
cards.description: To build and empower a vision in the ether by continually speaking what it is.

cards.title: OVER KILL
cards.description: To go overboard either emotionally or with information with something that didn't need it.

cards.title: AUTHORITY
cards.description: To value the power to enforce laws, exact obedience, command, determine or judge.

cards.title: BOUNDARY
cards.description: A point or limit that indicates where two things become different.

cards.title: CYCLES
cards.description: The harmonic relationships between objects in space & time.

cards.title: REPATTERNING
cards.description: A reappraisal of history to create a truer recounting of the events that occured to better understand the present and lead to a more balanced future.

cards.title: COMMUNICATION
cards.description: The subsystem that facilitates the flow of information throughout the system's network.

cards.title: INGESTION
cards.description: To discuss the entry of any resource into the system.

cards.title: CLEARING
cards.description: To clear the field of any tension, resentment, or misunderstanding.

cards.title: CREDIBILITY
cards.description: To build through accomplishments of the past your credibility in the present.

cards.title: BUTT IN
cards.description: To walk into a conversation that is already occurring and to just start talking.

cards.title: OVERWHELM
cards.description: To give too much information at either a rapid pace or at too high a level (or both).

cards.title: FREAK OUT
cards.description: To be out of emotional control to such a degree that everything around you become chaotic.

cards.title: SYNTHESIS
cards.description: To build parts into wholes so they can be understood how they fit into a whole.

cards.title: SOURCING
cards.description: To find the location of a needed resource and methodology and price to acquire it.

cards.title: INSTRUCTIONAL
cards.description: To teach a specific skill in a job or activity.

cards.title: SCHEDULING
cards.description: To get a synchronization between all people involved in some activity or event.

cards.title: FOLLOW-UP
cards.description: When an agreement has been made a follow-up occurs to make sure it occurs.

cards.title: CONNECTING
cards.description: To share your heart space in an intimate way to allow the flow of synergy.

cards.title: GUIDANCE
cards.description: To assist people towards finding their right path.

cards.title: DELEGATING
cards.description: To delegate tasks, missions, and work to specific people for them to complete.

cards.title: TESTING
cards.description: To have a conversation with a test within it to see how well someone does.

cards.title: DEBATE
cards.description: To argue both sides of a polarity to identify the pros and cons of each side.

cards.title: INVESTIGATION
cards.description: The find out what is required to be uncovered with a set goal in mind.

cards.title: ANALYSIS
cards.description: To break wholes down into parts so they can be examined rigorously.

cards.title: INTERVIEW
cards.description: To spend time with someone and find out about who they are and what they can do.

cards.title: INTERRUPTION
cards.description: To cut someone off in the middle of speaking at an inappropriate time.

cards.title: KNOWLEDGE SHARING
cards.description: To share knowledge freely in response to some question, problem, field, or issue.

cards.title: EXPLORATION
cards.description: To look into a question or field and discuss it freely without any restraints.

cards.title: PURCHASING
cards.description: To identify, select, and purchase the best resource for the required activity.

cards.title: EXTRUSION
cards.description: To discuss the exit of any resource out of a system.

cards.title: MAINTENANCE
cards.description: To take care of a resource and figure out the best way to maintain it.

cards.title: RELEASING
cards.description: The conversation that takes place to change a resource from active to inactive duty.

cards.title: LOGISTICAL
cards.description: The planning, implementation, and coordination of resources for an activity.

cards.title: SHARING
cards.description: To look at how to share a specific resource that is either owned by someone or the group.

cards.title: THEORETICAL
cards.description: To discuss the abstract theory of a subject being learned.

cards.title: REFLECTION
cards.description: To reflect on the significance of a resource and/or the meaning of an experience

cards.title: MOTIVATIONAL
cards.description: To go to the core of what inspires people and get them motivated.

cards.title: FEEDBACK
cards.description: Sharing knowledge of the results of any behavior, considered as influencing or modifying further performance.

cards.title: PROBLEM SOLVING
cards.description: A conversation with the intent to find a solution to a specific problem.

cards.title: DIRECTIONS
cards.description: To give the way to do something in a clear concise manner.

cards.title: BUILDING
cards.description: All the conversations that occur to build a specific product or gift.

cards.title: PREPARATION
cards.description: To get everyone ready to deliver the best service possible.

cards.title: NEGOTIATION
cards.description: To reach an agreement on what exchange can occur.

cards.title: ENROLLMENT
cards.description: To enroll someone's interest into an idea such they are an active participant.

cards.title: TEAM FOLLOW-UP
cards.description: To make follow-up contact with a prospect with more than one person.

cards.title: ADVOCATING
cards.description: To take a stand for someone regarding a job, mission, or endeavor.

cards.title: BLESSING
cards.description: To bless all the participants of an endeavor, mission, or accomplishment.

cards.title: SOB STORY
cards.description: To tell a story that you have told to everyone about some painful experience you had with no intention to heal, only to get sympathy.

cards.title: EXPLANATION
cards.description: To speak in such a way that people understand the situation.

cards.title: STORYTELLING
cards.description: To tell a story and take a listener down a path of understanding the whole through connecting the parts.

cards.title: REPORTING
cards.description: A conversation that gives the results when work has been done or not done.

cards.title: BRIEFING
cards.description: To get the people involved ready for an event or activity.

cards.title: TIMEOUT
cards.description: An immediate stoppage to discuss a new strategy or change in plans.

cards.title: ASSESSMENT
cards.description: To assess the level of value in regards to the exchange in an agreement or direction taken.

cards.title: DESIGNING
cards.description: All the conversations that occur to design a product or gift.
